title: Molten Aluminum-Induced Corrosion and Wear-Resistance Properties of ZrB<sub>2</sub>-Based Cermets Improved by Sintering-Temperature Manipulation.

recollection.structure: Guess: improved microstructure with enhanced grain refinement or densification
recollection.mechanism: Guess: improved corrosion and wear resistance due to optimized sintering temperature
recollection.results: Guess: enhanced corrosion and wear-resistance properties, possibly with quantitative metrics such as increased hardness or reduced wear rate

score.note: The recollection only gives generic, title-level claims. It identifies variation of sintering temperature and vaguely suggests densification, but omits SPS, the 1300–1600 °C range, binder filling/loss and porosity details, molten-Al penetration and wear mechanisms, the 1500 °C optimum, and all numerical results.
